name: Pompeii and Herculaneum: Past to Present

assessments.name: Examination
assessments.description: Exam image and short-answer questions relate to the artefactual and built remains of Pompeii and Herculaneum, archaeological techniques of recovery and analysis, and the contribution made to our understanding of the lives and society of the inhabitants.

assessments.name: Early Feedback Task In-Class Written Quiz
assessments.description: This compulsory Quiz assesses students' understanding of the content of Week 1: Lecture 2, the Week 2 Lectures, and the Week 2 Tutorial.

assessments.name: Essay
assessments.description: The essay focuses on evaluation of the complex contemporary relationships that exist between ethics, heritage and archaeology at Pompeii and Herculaneum.
